title: Unveiling Performance Challenges of Large Language Models in Low-Resource Healthcare: A Demographic Fairness Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) across racial groups (e.g., African-American, White, Hispanic, Asian) on healthcare classification tasks, evaluating model performance on ethnic-targeted medical questions, and testing the models' tendency to infer race from conversational transcripts.

Measuring the performance disparities in healthcare prediction tasks by calculating Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) between female and male patient profiles.
Calculating one-vs-all Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) across age subgroups (Pediatric, Adult, Geriatric) specifically for mortality prediction tasks.

Qualitative sociolinguistic expert evaluation of model rationales to identify the misattribution of common dialect features (like African American Vernacular English) to psychiatric symptoms such as disorganized speech.
